channels.name: Doge
channels.tagline: One Shiba. Every bad idea in crypto.
channels.style: The Doge: a golden Shiba Inu wearing a black baseball cap, expressive, slapstick comedy, cinematic lighting, 24fps, no text on screen.
channels.system: A golden Shiba Inu in a black cap called the Doge stumbles through the crypto world. Every scene is a joke with a punchline. Never cruel, always absurd.

rounds.beat: Morning. The Doge checks the charts.

options.label: Doge sees a giant red candle and screams
options.prompt: The Doge stares at a wall of monitors as a huge red candle appears, jaw drops, coffee mug slides off the desk in slow motion.

options.label: Doge finds his wallet went to zero
options.prompt: The Doge taps a phone, sees a balance of zero, flips the phone in the air, catches it, taps again, still zero, sighs dramatically.

options.label: Doge tries to buy the dip with a credit card
options.prompt: The Doge frantically swipes a credit card through a laptop keyboard like a card reader, sparks fly, the screen says DECLINED.

options.label: Doge naps on a pile of hardware wallets
options.prompt: The Doge sleeps blissfully on a mountain of small metal hardware wallets, one paw twitching, a dream bubble showing a rocket.

options.label: Doge vs the Orange Man in a boxing ring
options.prompt: The Doge in red boxing gloves bounces in a boxing ring facing a very tan man with a blond swoop hairstyle and a long red tie, the crowd roars.

options.label: Doge testifies to a Senate committee
options.prompt: The Doge sits at a wooden hearing table in a tiny suit in front of a row of stern senators, adjusts a microphone, raises one paw to swear in.

options.label: Doge gets a job at a Wall Street desk
options.prompt: The Doge in a pinstripe suit at a Wall Street trading floor, three phones ringing, paws slamming keyboards, papers flying.

options.label: Doge is interviewed by a hostile TV host
options.prompt: The Doge on a cable news set, a shouting host jabs a finger, the Doge tilts its head, very confused, a graphic behind reads nothing.

options.label: Doge launches on a homemade rocket to the moon
options.prompt: The Doge strapped to a cardboard rocket in a backyard, fuse lit, launch, the rocket climbs past clouds, the Doge grins with ears flapping.

options.label: Doge wins the boxing match by accident
options.prompt: The Doge trips in the boxing ring, its glove swings up and accidentally lands a knockout, the referee lifts the Doge's paw, confetti falls.

options.label: Doge gets chased by a mob of angry investors
options.prompt: The Doge sprints down a city street chased by a crowd in suits waving printed charts, dives into a taxi.

options.label: Doge accidentally becomes a senator
options.prompt: The Doge is handed a gavel at the hearing table, bangs it once, everyone stands and applauds, the Doge looks terrified.

rounds.beat: The Doge is somewhere it should not be.

options.label: Doge lands on the moon and plants a flag
options.prompt: The Doge in a tiny spacesuit bounces on the lunar surface, plants a flag with a paw print on it, Earth rises behind.

options.label: Doge hosts a press conference
options.prompt: The Doge at a podium with a dozen microphones, flashbulbs popping, holds up a single paw for silence, then yawns.

options.label: Doge runs a lemonade stand that accepts only coins
options.prompt: The Doge behind a lemonade stand with a sign showing coin symbols, a long line of customers holding phones, the Doge pours lemonade.

options.label: Doge gets stuck in an elevator with the Orange Man
options.prompt: The Doge and a very tan man with a blond swoop hairstyle stand awkwardly in a stopped elevator, both look at the ceiling, the lights flicker.

options.label: Doge rides a golden bull down Wall Street
options.prompt: The Doge rides a charging golden bull statue come to life down Wall Street, traders leap aside, ticker tape rains down.

options.label: Doge returns from the moon to a hero's welcome
options.prompt: A capsule splashes down, the hatch opens, the Doge emerges in a spacesuit waving, boats honk, a rainbow.

options.label: Doge falls asleep mid-victory speech
options.prompt: The Doge on a stage at a podium mid-speech slowly leans on the podium and falls asleep, the crowd applauds anyway.

options.label: Doge sells everything and buys a doghouse
options.prompt: The Doge signs a paper with a paw print, receives a golden key, walks into a tiny red doghouse with a satellite dish, closes the door.

channels.name: Chaos
channels.tagline: No rules, no plot, no mercy.
channels.style: Hyper-real cinematic, wide lens, dramatic lighting, absurd premise played completely straight, 24fps, no text on screen.
channels.system: Anything can happen. Every scene is a new impossible thing filmed as if it were real.

options.label: A cat delivers a TED talk
options.prompt: A tabby cat stands at a podium on a red circle stage delivering a talk to a rapt audience, slides behind it, dramatic paw gesture.

options.label: A volcano erupts confetti
options.prompt: A snow-capped volcano erupts, but the plume is millions of pieces of colorful confetti drifting over a small village, villagers cheer.

options.label: Grandma wins a drag race
options.prompt: An elderly woman in a cardigan does a burnout in a purple muscle car at a drag strip, launches, wins, waves from the window.

options.label: Fish learn to walk today
options.prompt: Thousands of small fish walk out of the ocean onto a beach on tiny legs, sunbathers stare, one fish holds a beach ball.

options.label: The moon lands on Earth for a visit
options.prompt: A colossal moon gently touches down in a wheat field, dust rolls out, a farmer looks up from a tractor, unimpressed.

options.label: A traffic jam of dinosaurs
options.prompt: A rush-hour freeway packed with dinosaurs in the lanes instead of cars, a T-rex honks a horn, a helicopter reports overhead.

options.label: Skyscrapers play musical chairs
options.prompt: Downtown skyscrapers slide across the city grid swapping positions like musical chairs, pedestrians hold onto lampposts.

options.label: It rains rubber ducks
options.prompt: A thunderstorm over a city where yellow rubber ducks fall instead of rain, bouncing off umbrellas and filling the streets.

rounds.beat: Somebody has to deal with it.

options.label: The army deploys against the ducks
options.prompt: Soldiers in full gear advance down a street knee-deep in rubber ducks, a commander shouts into a radio, a duck squeaks under a boot.

options.label: A toddler negotiates with the dinosaurs
options.prompt: A toddler in a diaper stands on the freeway holding a juice box, addressing a bowing T-rex, news cameras roll.

options.label: The moon apologizes on live TV
options.prompt: A news studio interview where the guest is a giant moon with a gentle glowing face, the host nods sympathetically.

options.label: The cat runs for mayor
options.prompt: The tabby cat in a small tie waves from a campaign bus, crowds hold signs with a paw print, balloons everywhere.

options.label: The ocean stands up and walks away
options.prompt: The entire ocean rises into a towering walking figure of water and strides inland, ships slide off its shoulders, people watch from a cliff.

options.label: Gravity takes a lunch break
options.prompt: In a city square everything floats gently upward, cars, pigeons, a hot dog cart, a man calmly eats a floating sandwich.

options.label: The sun sets in the wrong place
options.prompt: The sun slowly sets into the middle of a city street between two buildings, steam rises from the asphalt, drivers wait at a red light.

options.label: Every statue comes alive and stretches
options.prompt: Bronze and marble statues across a European plaza step off their plinths, stretch and yawn like they've been standing for centuries.

options.label: Everyone floats up into a giant group hug
options.prompt: Thousands of people float upward above a city and drift into one enormous slow group hug in the clouds at sunset.

options.label: The cat is sworn in as mayor
options.prompt: The tabby cat places a paw on a book at a ceremony on city hall steps, cannons fire confetti, a marching band plays.

options.label: The ocean comes back and lies down
options.prompt: The walking ocean figure returns to the coast and slowly lies down, becoming the sea again, waves settle, a surfer catches the first wave.

options.label: Fade to a single rubber duck
options.prompt: A quiet street at dawn covered in rubber ducks, one duck slowly rotates toward camera and blinks.

channels.name: Sitcom
channels.tagline: Three roommates, one apartment, zero rent paid.
channels.style: Multi-camera 90s sitcom look, warm studio lighting, a cozy apartment set with a couch and a kitchen behind, three roommates: Priya (short black hair, red hoodie), Max (tall, curly hair, glasses), Jo (blonde, denim jacket), 24fps, no text on screen.
channels.system: A classic sitcom about three roommates. Every scene is a setup and a punchline. Keep it warm.

options.label: Max has adopted a goat
options.prompt: Max walks in the apartment door leading a small goat on a leash, Priya and Jo freeze on the couch mid-snack, the goat eats a magazine.

options.label: The rent is due and nobody has it
options.prompt: The three roommates sit around the kitchen table staring at an envelope marked with a red stamp, Jo slowly slides it toward Max.

options.label: Priya's date is the landlord
options.prompt: Priya opens the front door dressed up for a date, the man at the door is the grumpy landlord holding flowers, Max chokes on cereal.

options.label: Jo built a hot tub in the living room
options.prompt: Jo sits in a hot tub in the middle of the living room wearing sunglasses, Priya and Max stand in the doorway holding groceries.

options.label: They start a goat yoga business
options.prompt: The living room is full of strangers doing yoga while the goat walks across their backs, Max collects cash at the door.

options.label: They rent the hot tub by the hour
options.prompt: A queue of neighbors in bathrobes waits in the hallway, Jo takes bookings on a clipboard, Priya hands out towels.

options.label: Max pretends to be a famous chef
options.prompt: Max in a tall chef hat flips a pancake that sticks to the ceiling, Priya films on a phone, Jo applauds.

options.label: Priya fakes an engagement to the landlord
options.prompt: Priya shows off a ring made of a pop-tab to the landlord at the door, Max and Jo peek from behind the couch, the goat bleats.

options.label: The goat eats the rent money
options.prompt: The goat chews a fan of cash on the kitchen table while the three roommates lunge in slow motion to stop it.

options.label: The hot tub leaks into the downstairs apartment
options.prompt: Water pours through the ceiling of the neighbor's apartment below onto a man reading a newspaper, he keeps reading.

options.label: The landlord brings his mother to dinner
options.prompt: An awkward dinner at the tiny table, the landlord's tiny elderly mother inspects Priya through thick glasses, Max serves burnt pancakes.

options.label: A health inspector shows up
options.prompt: A stern health inspector in a suit stands in the doorway with a clipboard while a goat yoga class is in full swing behind Max.

options.label: They hide the goat in the fridge
options.prompt: Max shoves the goat gently into the refrigerator as the inspector turns around, the goat's face peeks out from behind a milk carton.

options.label: Jo distracts everyone with a song
options.prompt: Jo stands on the coffee table playing a ukulele very loudly, the inspector taps a foot despite himself, Priya mops water.

options.label: Priya confesses everything
options.prompt: Priya stands and delivers a dramatic confession at dinner, arms wide, the landlord's mother slowly starts to laugh.

options.label: Max blames the goat for everything
options.prompt: Max points at the goat, the goat looks at Max, the whole room looks at the goat, the goat bleats once.

options.label: The landlord's mother moves in
options.prompt: The tiny elderly mother sits on the couch between the roommates holding the goat, remote in hand, everyone stares at the TV in silence.

options.label: The goat pays the rent
options.prompt: The goat drops a chewed but complete envelope of cash at the landlord's feet at the door, the landlord picks it up, nods, leaves.

options.label: They all end up in the hot tub
options.prompt: The three roommates, the landlord and the goat sit in the hot tub together, sunglasses on, Jo raises a glass.

options.label: Max adopts a second goat
options.prompt: Max walks in the door leading two goats, Priya and Jo scream in unison, the first goat looks delighted.

channels.name: Anime
channels.tagline: Neo-Kyoto, 2099. A courier with a past.
channels.style: 2D anime style, cel shading, dynamic camera, rain-soaked neon city Neo-Kyoto, hero: Rin, a young courier with a silver bob haircut, orange jacket, hoverbike, 24fps, no text on screen.
channels.system: A cyberpunk anime about Rin, a courier who delivers the wrong package. Action with heart.

options.label: Rin picks up a glowing package
options.prompt: Rin receives a small box glowing blue from a hooded figure under a noodle stand awning, rain sheets down, neon reflects on wet ground.

options.label: Rin races a police drone through traffic
options.prompt: Rin on a hoverbike weaves between flying cars in a neon canyon while a red police drone chases, sparks off a billboard.

options.label: Rin's bike stalls above the city
options.prompt: Rin's hoverbike sputters and dips above a glittering skyline, Rin thumps the dashboard, the engine roars back with blue flame.

options.label: Rin gets a call from a stranger
options.prompt: Rin's wrist screen lights up with an unknown caller, a distorted masked face appears, Rin narrows her eyes under the rain.

options.label: A tiny robot fox jumps out
options.prompt: The glowing box opens and a small robotic fox with glowing eyes leaps out onto Rin's shoulder, sniffs, and chirps.

options.label: The package is a map to the old city
options.prompt: A hologram unfolds from the box showing a 3D map of a buried old city under Neo-Kyoto, a red marker pulses.

options.label: A mech wakes up from the box
options.prompt: The small box unfolds and expands into a three-story mech that towers over Rin in an alley, eyes lighting up one by one.

options.label: It is someone's memories
options.prompt: The box projects flickering memories of a girl with Rin's face in a sunlit field, Rin drops the box in shock.

options.label: A gang of neon samurai blocks the road
options.prompt: Five figures in neon-lined armor with glowing katanas stand in a rain-slick street blocking Rin's hoverbike, steam rises.

options.label: A corporate gunship descends
options.prompt: A massive corporate gunship with searchlights drops between skyscrapers, spotlights sweep across Rin on her bike.

options.label: Rin's old partner reappears
options.prompt: A tall man in a long black coat steps from the shadows with a scarred face, Rin's expression flickers between anger and relief.

options.label: The city's AI speaks through every screen
options.prompt: Every billboard in the neon street switches to the same glowing eye that turns to look at Rin, rain freezes in the air for a second.

options.label: The mech and Rin fight side by side
options.prompt: The mech punches through a gunship while Rin on her hoverbike loops around it firing a grappling line, explosion of sparks.

options.label: Rin outruns everyone through a train tunnel
options.prompt: Rin's hoverbike screams through a maglev tunnel inches ahead of a train, the robot fox clings to her jacket.

options.label: The robot fox hacks the gunship
options.prompt: The tiny robot fox leaps onto the gunship hull, eyes flash, the gunship's lights turn from red to blue and it lowers its weapons.

options.label: Rin duels the neon samurai leader
options.prompt: Rin, holding a glowing wrench like a sword, clashes with the samurai leader's katana on a rooftop in the rain, slow motion sparks.

options.label: Rin delivers the package after all
options.prompt: Rin hands the glowing box to an old woman on a quiet rooftop garden at sunrise, the old woman smiles and bows.

options.label: Rin keeps the robot fox
options.prompt: Rin rides her hoverbike into a golden sunrise above the city with the robot fox on her shoulder, wind in her silver hair.

options.label: The old city rises
options.prompt: Ancient towers rise out of the ground beneath Neo-Kyoto at dawn, glowing with old symbols, Rin watches from a bridge.

options.label: Rin finds the girl from the memories
options.prompt: Rin steps into a sunlit field at the edge of the city where a girl with her face waits, both slowly raise a hand.

channels.name: Storybook
channels.tagline: A bear, a lantern, and a very long night.
channels.style: Painterly children's picture book style, soft watercolor textures, gentle warm light, hero: a small brown bear cub named Pip in a yellow scarf carrying a lantern, 24fps, no text on screen.
channels.system: A gentle bedtime story about Pip the bear cub looking for the moon. Wonder, no fear.

options.label: Pip notices the moon is gone
options.prompt: Pip the bear cub stands at the window of a cozy treehouse looking at a starry sky with no moon, lantern in paw, ears droop.

options.label: An owl says the moon fell in the lake
options.prompt: A large wise owl on a branch whispers to Pip and points a wing toward a shimmering lake in the forest.

options.label: Pip finds moon footprints in the snow
options.prompt: Pip crouches with the lantern over glowing silver footprints in fresh snow leading into a dark forest.

options.label: The stars ask Pip for help
options.prompt: Tiny stars drift down from the sky and circle around Pip's lantern, tugging at the yellow scarf toward the forest.

options.label: Pip crosses a river on a turtle
options.prompt: Pip rides on the back of a huge friendly turtle across a moonless river, lantern lighting the ripples, fireflies follow.

options.label: Pip meets a fox who lost his shadow
options.prompt: A small red fox sits sadly on a log, Pip holds the lantern up and the fox's shadow reappears, the fox jumps for joy.

options.label: Pip climbs the tallest tree
options.prompt: Pip climbs a giant tree with a lantern hooked on a paw, the forest spreads out below, an owl watches.

options.label: Pip finds a door in a hill
options.prompt: Pip pushes open a tiny round wooden door in a grassy hill, warm golden light spills out.

options.label: The moon is asleep in the lake
options.prompt: Pip looks over the edge of the turtle's shell and sees the moon sleeping under the water, softly snoring, bubbles rising.

options.label: A whale carries the moon on its back
options.prompt: A great gentle whale glides through the night sky above the forest with the moon resting on its back, Pip waves from a treetop.

options.label: Inside the hill is a moon-repair workshop
options.prompt: Inside the hill, tiny mice in aprons polish the moon on a workbench with cloths, the moon giggles, Pip peeks in.

options.label: The moon is hiding because it is shy
options.prompt: Pip finds the moon peeking out from behind a mountain, blushing pink, Pip holds up the lantern like a friendly wave.

options.label: Pip tickles the moon awake
options.prompt: Pip leans over the water and gently tickles the sleeping moon with a feather, the moon giggles and rises dripping into the sky.

options.label: Pip sings the moon a song
options.prompt: Pip sits on the whale's back singing softly with eyes closed, the moon glows brighter with every note, stars gather.

options.label: Pip gives the moon the yellow scarf
options.prompt: Pip wraps the yellow scarf around the shy moon, the moon smiles and floats up wearing the scarf.

options.label: The mice let Pip polish the last spot
options.prompt: Pip polishes a small dull spot on the moon with a tiny cloth until it shines, the mice cheer and toss their aprons.

options.label: The moon carries Pip home
options.prompt: The moon, wearing a yellow scarf, floats over the forest carrying a sleepy Pip curled on top, back toward the treehouse.

options.label: All the animals watch the moonrise
options.prompt: Pip, the fox, the turtle, the owl and the mice sit in a row on a hill watching the full moon rise, lantern between them.

options.label: Pip falls asleep on the whale
options.prompt: Pip sleeps curled on the whale's back as it drifts slowly across a sky now full of moonlight, the lantern flickers out.

options.label: The moon tucks Pip into bed
options.prompt: Moonlight pours through the treehouse window and gently pulls a blanket over sleeping Pip, the lantern glows on the sill.

channels.name: After Dark
channels.tagline: Unfiltered. Horror, dark comedy, no safety rails.
channels.style: Gritty 35mm horror film look, high contrast, deep shadows, practical-effects feel, unsettling, 24fps, no text on screen.
channels.system: A late-night horror anthology. Dark, strange, gory when it earns it. Uncensored, never illegal.

options.label: The bartender has no face
options.prompt: A dim roadside bar, the bartender turns around and has smooth skin where a face should be, a lone drinker slowly lowers his glass.

options.label: A hitchhiker with wet footprints
options.prompt: Night highway, headlights reveal a soaked hitchhiker in a dry desert, wet footprints trail behind him into darkness.

options.label: The motel TV shows the viewer's room
options.prompt: A man in a motel room watches the TV show a live feed of his own room from behind him, he slowly turns to look at the corner.

options.label: The elevator goes to floor 13
options.prompt: A hotel elevator's button panel lights up a 13 that was not there before, the doors open onto a corridor of dripping red wallpaper.

options.label: The faceless bartender pours something alive
options.prompt: The faceless bartender pours a black liquid that writhes and reaches out of the glass toward the drinker's hand.

options.label: The hitchhiker is already in the back seat
options.prompt: The driver glances in the rearview mirror, the hitchhiker sits in the back seat dripping water, smiling too wide.

options.label: The figure in the corner steps closer on the TV
options.prompt: On the motel TV the dark figure in the corner of the room takes one step forward, the man does not dare turn around again.

options.label: Something knocks from inside the walls
options.prompt: In the red corridor a rhythmic knocking comes from inside the walls, the wallpaper bulges outward in the shape of a hand.

options.label: The bar's door opens into the same bar
options.prompt: The drinker bursts out of the bar door and runs into the identical bar again, the faceless bartender waits, polishing a glass.

options.label: The car will not stop accelerating
options.prompt: The driver stamps the brake, the speedometer climbs, the hitchhiker leans forward between the seats, water pours from his sleeves.

options.label: The man climbs out the motel window
options.prompt: The man crawls out of a motel bathroom window into a parking lot where every car's headlights turn on at once.

options.label: The hand pulls someone into the wall
options.prompt: A wallpaper hand grabs a hotel guest by the ankle and drags him into the wall, the wallpaper smooths over, a shoe is left behind.

options.label: Everyone in the bar has no face
options.prompt: The drinker turns to the room and every patron at every table slowly looks up with no face, the jukebox plays on.

options.label: The hitchhiker is the driver's drowned brother
options.prompt: The hitchhiker's face in the mirror becomes the driver's own face, bloated and pale, mouthing the driver's name.

options.label: The parking lot cars are full of mannequins
options.prompt: Every parked car holds a mannequin family staring straight ahead, one mannequin's head slowly turns toward the man.

options.label: Floor 13 is a room full of beds with the guests
options.prompt: A vast hotel ballroom of hospital beds with every guest of the hotel asleep and wired to the walls, wallpaper pulsing like veins.

options.label: The drinker takes his seat at the bar forever
options.prompt: The drinker slowly sits back down at the bar, the bartender slides a fresh glass, the drinker's face begins to smooth over.

options.label: The car drives into a lake
options.prompt: The car plunges off a bridge into a black lake, headlights fading underwater, the hitchhiker stands dry on the bridge above.

options.label: The motel sign flickers to VACANCY
options.prompt: The motel neon sign buzzes from NO VACANCY to VACANCY, a mannequin hand rests on the front desk bell.

options.label: The elevator doors close with you inside
options.prompt: Elevator doors close on a hallway full of faceless guests, the panel lights 13 again, and the descent begins.
